correctness.rationale: The 30-vertex duad/syntheme incidence graph is specified by 15 pair vertices and 15 perfect pair partitions, with 45 edges. Each perfect matching is a 15-entry distinct duad assignment to synthemes; complete backtracking enumerates exactly 288. Two separately inspected source verifiers use (a) relative-permutation cycles and (b) explicit simple eight-cycle flips. Independently written exhaustive Python enumeration reconstructed the 288 matchings, exactly 1440 undirected exchanges, ten regular neighbors, the complement (10,20) and (30) strata of 144 matchings each, radius 5, diameter 6 and the complete stated distance profiles. All 41,328 pairs were evaluated by breadth-first search and tested for one Hamiltonian 30-cycle symmetric difference; exactly 144 unordered pairs meet both conditions. The computation is exhaustive for this one finite explicitly specified graph, not for other graphs or flip lengths.
